2 هُوَ يُعَطِّينِى , (S, K, TA,) with teshdeed, (S, TA,) thus in the M, as well as the S, erroneously written in [some of] the copies of the K يُعْطِينِى, (TA,) He serves me, does service for me, or ministers to me; as also ↓ يُعَاطِينِى . (S, K, TA.) You say, مَنْ يُعَطِّيكَ i. e. Who has the office of serving thee? (TA.) ＝
-A2- And عَطَّيْتُهُ I incited him, or made him, to hasten, or be quick. (Sgh, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
